backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Chapter and PdfEntry types with full CRUD operations (add, update, delete, get, getAll) for both entities, using in-memory Maps and auto-incrementing IDs.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms the old Chapter schema (with binary audio blob fields and a single audioUrl) into the new schema (with audioUrl1/audioUrl2 URL strings and no blob fields), preserving all other data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two completed features: replacing audio file-upload inputs with plain URL text fields in ChapterForm, and updating ChapterPage/AudioPlayer to play audio directly from stored URL strings without canister blob fetching.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key changes of each component, page, hook, and utility in the frontend/src directory.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining light and dark mode CSS custom properties (design tokens) for colors, borders, and sidebar used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Study Sphere Pakistan PWA, loading Inter/Poppins fonts, linking the web manifest, and mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Study Sphere Pakistan, defining app name, display mode, theme colors, and a single 256x256 icon.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing a cache-first with network-update strategy for same-origin GET requests, pre-caching key static assets on install and cleaning up old caches on activate.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the React app with TanStack Router (all page routes), React Query, dark mode context/provider, a shared Layout with Header/Footer, and a splash screen shown once per session.
frontend/src/components/AdminAuthGuard.t: Empty file, likely a placeholder for an admin authentication guard component.
frontend/src/components/AudioPlayer.tsx: A custom audio player component with play/pause, seek, volume, mute controls and an error fallback that shows an external link when the audio cannot be played inline.
frontend/src/components/ChapterCard.tsx: Displays a chapter as a clickable card showing its title, available feature badges (Notes, Audio, Quiz, Flashcards), and a completion checkmark if the chapter is marked done.
frontend/src/components/ChapterForm.tsx: A form component for creating or editing a chapter, including fields for title, class, subject, notes URLs, audio URLs, quiz questions, and flashcards, with save/cancel actions.
frontend/src/components/ClassPage.tsx: An intentionally empty placeholder file; the actual ClassPage component lives in the pages directory.
frontend/src/components/FlashcardSection: Renders an interactive flashcard carousel with flip animation, previous/next navigation, and swipe gesture support for touch devices.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying the StudyHub brand, quick navigation links, legal disclaimer, copyright, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky navigation header with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, dark mode toggle, and a hamburger menu for mobile viewports.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper that composes Header, Footer, and a TanStack Router Outlet into a full-height flex column.
frontend/src/components/NotesViewer.tsx: Renders a Google Drive or generic PDF URL in an iframe with fallback states for missing or broken URLs and an open-in-new-tab button.
frontend/src/components/PdfEntryForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing a PDF entry (title, type, URL) that calls add/update mutation hooks on submit.
frontend/src/components/QuizSection.tsx: Step-through quiz UI that tracks selected answers, shows per-question feedback, and displays a scored results screen with a retry option.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: Full-screen animated splash screen shown on app load that auto-dismisses with a fade-out after 2 seconds.
frontend/src/contexts/DarkModeContext.ts: React context provider that persists and toggles dark mode by adding/removing the 'dark' class on the document root and syncing to storage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) via React Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity auth hook and provider that manages AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flow, delegation validity, and exposes identity and status to consumers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for CRUD operations on chapters and PDF entries, wrapping backend actor calls with query invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and includes flashcard 3D flip animation styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabbed views for managing chapters and PDF entries, supporting add/edit/delete operations via form sub-views and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ChapterPage.tsx: Detail page for a single chapter that displays tabbed content including notes viewer, audio player, quiz, and flashcard sections with completion tracking.
frontend/src/pages/ClassPage.tsx: Subject selection page for a given class number, displaying a grid of Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and English navigation cards.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with a hero section, class/MDCAT navigation buttons, a search bar, and a feature highlights grid.
frontend/src/pages/MDCATPage.tsx: MDCAT prep landing page displaying subject navigation buttons and lists of past papers and practice tests fetched from the backend, with delete functionality for PDF entries.
frontend/src/pages/MDCATSubjectPage.tsx: Subject-specific MDCAT page that filters chapters by subject, supports search, and shows recently viewed chapters with navigation to individual chapter pages.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectPage.tsx: Class-specific subject page that filters chapters by class number and subject, supports search, and displays recently viewed chapters with navigation to chapter detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/SupportPage.tsx: Support page displaying an Easypaisa donation number with a copy-to-clipboard button and step-by-step instructions for sending a payment.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Terms and conditions page listing usage policies for StudyHub, with a hidden clickable text that navigates to the admin route.
frontend/src/types/chapter.ts: TypeScript interfaces defining the frontend data models for Chapter, PdfEntry, QuizQuestion, and FlashcardItem.
frontend/src/utils/audioUploadService.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for an audio upload service utility.
frontend/src/utils/audioUploadService2.t: Empty file, likely a second placeholder for an alternate audio upload service utility.
frontend/src/utils/callWithRetry.ts: Generic async utility that wraps a canister call with configurable timeout and retry logic, racing against a timeout promise.
frontend/src/utils/chapterMapper.ts: Mapper functions that convert backend Chapter and PdfEntry types (with bigint IDs and JSON strings) into frontend-friendly types with string IDs and parsed arrays.
frontend/src/utils/hashPassword.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for a password hashing utility.
frontend/src/utils/jsonValidation.ts: Provides validation functions for quiz and flashcard JSON strings, checking structure and field types, along with example JSON constants for each format.
frontend/src/utils/storageService.ts: Manages device-local user data (recently viewed chapters, completed chapters, dark mode preference) using localStorage, while canister backend handles chapter CRUD.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode strategy, custom CSS-variable-based color tokens, fonts, border radii, and keyframe animations including accordion and fade-in effects.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 33) for Study Sphere Pakistan, documenting the app summary, architectural decisions, existing features, and known issues.
